issues.description: Method addGuestStudents: the problem statement (task description and UML) requires a public method addGuestStudents(int) — a single int parameter. The solution implements public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) (single int parameter) consistent with the specification. The template, however, declares public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) (an extra boolean parameter). This signature mismatch between the template and the specified API/solution will cause compilation/test discrepancies and confuse students about which public method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template's public method signature to match the problem statement and solution: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { ... }. If input validation is desired, perform it inside this single-parameter method or delegate to a private helper; do not expose an extra boolean parameter in the public API so that the template, problem statement, tests, and solution are consistent.
